Yes, making saved copies optional per bookmark is the right choice. The local copy and Internet Archive capture should remain independent, and a failed capture must never remove or block the bookmark; showing the failure and allowing a retry is right.

For an ordinary web page, please store the local snapshot as one self-contained HTML file so it can be moved or backed up without missing pieces. For a PDF, storing the original PDF itself is correct. With that condition, the saved-copy behaviour matches what I want.
